source: docs/v1-spec.md, Feasibility math. Starting defaults, user-overridable. Recalibrated 2026-10-29 against data/reference/test_parcels.csv (see docs/calibration-2026-10-29.md). Base costs are provisional until the partner contractor's actual job costs are in.

production.note: small-builder spec flats; evidence in docs/construction-costs-2026-10-29.md (Missing Middle awards, NAHB, test-set sales)

build_spec_presets.status: set from published evidence 2026-10-29 (docs/construction-costs-2026-10-29.md); replace with real job costs when available

escalation.rule: preset x index now / base value, monthly; show base month and change

neighborhood_adjustment: 1 + 0.5 * (index - 1), index from data/reference/cost_index_by_area_v2.csv (computed within unit-count groups)
sprinklers_note: applies to the building with 4+ units; a detached coach house does not add the main building's count (verify against the 2026 code)

permit_fee.construction_factor_status: placeholder until confirmed from city fee tables

formula.base: cost_before_financing = land + hard + sprinklers + contingency + soft + permit
formula.note: computed on cost before financing, so there is no circular reference

reference_margin_on_cost.also_show: margin on revenue = profit / net sale

buyer_financing.display: financing class per scenario; flag whole-building price above the FHA limit

reference_tests.display: reference lines beside the result; never a pass/fail verdict

margins_by_stage.applies_to: all cost lines except land; land is a known or entered price

sale_value_range.note: profit range = low sale minus high cost, to high sale minus low cost

sale_comps.pool: 2-6 unit buildings (class 211, x54s-btds) and condo units in 2-6 unit buildings (3r7i-mrz4) built 2014 or later, first arm's-length sale after construction (wvhk-k5uv)
sale_comps.search: same unit-count group within 0.75 mi, then 1.5 mi, then any unit count within 1.5 mi, then 3 mi; at least 6 comps; sales within 4 years

time_adjustment.index: FHFA HPI annual by census tract, then ZIP, then Chicago metro quarterly
time_adjustment.note: public domain; can be shown on screen

land_value_map.source: Germany Bodenrichtwerte and Singapore price per buildable area (docs/international-practices.md)
measures: land sale price per sq ft of lot
land sale price per buildable sq ft (lot area x FAR of the current district)
land_value_map.sales: vacant land (class 100, 190, 241) and teardown sales (building value under 20% of assessed value) in the last 36 months
land_value_map.unit: Assessor neighborhood; fall back to community area, then side of city

residual.name: residual land value (shown as max land price)
residual.formula: net sale / (1 + target return) - (total cost - land)
profit_shown_as: percent of net sale value (margin on value)
residual.existing_use_check: for parcels with a building: compare residual land value with existing-use value (Assessor market value from assessed value) and flag when residual is below it; owner may not sell at a price that works

show.P80: central x (1 + high margin for the stage)

cost_confidence.refit: replace the stage margins with percentiles of actual overrun from users completed projects once 20 or more exist

cost_index_method.thin_areas: blend with the side-of-city index (North, Northwest, West, Southwest, South, Far South) weighted by permit count until the area has 10 or more permits

fast_path.source: Japan by-right zoning, NSW complying development, Chicago self-certification
fast_path.definition: by-right units and floor area, no zoning relief, 1-8 units (self-certification eligible), not landmark, no demolition hold
fast_path.show: filter and badge with estimated weeks to permit

permit_duration.source: Chicago building permits ydr8-5enu, processing_time for the 836 permits behind the cost index
permit_duration.use: months of land carry before construction = days / 30; job recomputes monthly by review path

open_space_impact_fee.formula: persons_by_unit_size x 87 sq ft per person x open_space_cost_per_sqft x 0.30, rounded per unit

open_space_cost_per_sqft.2028+: lesser of prior x Chicago CPI or 102.5%

open_space_impact_fee.exemptions: replacement unit with a demolition permit under one year old; credits for on-site open space
open_space_impact_fee.check: 2025 worksheet shows $418/$836/$1,254/$1,672, matching the formula at $16
